$comment: Architecture budgets for the 2026-11-07 SOLID remediation program. Measured by scripts/architecture-budget.mjs. `max` is the ceiling enforced by `npm run architecture:check`; `target` is the program-end value. Budgets were tightened to the achieved end state at program close (2026-11-07) so the remediation cannot silently regress. Audit numbers come from docs/archive/2026-11-07-solid-principles-audit.md; measured baselines and deviations are recorded in docs/solid-remediation-decisions.md.

baseline.audit: 2026-11-07 SOLID audit (measured on 20bc219; tree advanced by 5a31bf7 before execution)

largestPageFileLines.note: dashboard/src/pages/Codebook.tsx (149); every page is now a router shell.

largestBackendModuleLines.note: WS3c split the persistence repository and the domain oversight service; WS3b brought scheduler.ts to 98.

pageFilesDefiningDataHooks.note: WS5/WS6: no page entry file owns data access; hooks live in pages/<page>/ hook files.

providerSettingsPolicySites.note: packages/domain/src/providers/settings.ts is the only supported-sampling-control list; WS6 removed the dashboard copy.

providerNameBranchSites.note: Recorded integration change: dashboard presentation checks (fixture badge, capacity copy, model-call reasoning label, pair-table designation) read an already-resolved run configuration to pick copy; they are not provider policy. Backend sites read registry data. Wave-2 added the pair-table presentation branch.

scenarioVersionLiteralSites.note: Literal version strings only. Remaining: scenario definitions in contracts/domain plus the dashboard-owned presentation fallback (metadata-unavailable path). WS4 replaced the 14 baseline copies with one definition plus constant references.

scenarioVersionConstantReferences.note: References to HEALTHCARE_SCENARIO_VERSION: the single-source form, not a copy of the policy.

byteIdenticalDuplicateFiles.note: WS4 deleted the duplicated inference-provider resolver.

statusVocabularyTableDefinitions.note: Canonical vocabulary tables (RUN_STATUSES/terminal+active sets, JOB_STATUSES/active+retryable, MONITOR_EVALUATION_STATUSES/active, EVIDENCE_KINDS, SIDE_EFFECT_CATEGORIES, MONITOR_VIEW_BUILDERS, dashboard status.ts tables and the feature tables added by the wave-2 integrations such as healthcare-results status metadata and run-detail tab metadata). Each is the single source for its vocabulary; ad-hoc copies are counted by statusVocabularyDuplicateSites instead.

statusVocabularyDuplicateSites.note: Ad-hoc status arrays outside the canonical tables: two dashboard UI grouping arrays in lib/status.ts (presentation groups, not policy) and one compound Mongo $or in analysis persistence. Down from the audit's 8 terminal subsets / the 29-site superset.
